title: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.08006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. translated_title: 自动关键词抽取与标注：面向文本与语音的现代理论方法与实践方案
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.08006v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：文本及视听信息的爆炸式增长使得自动关键词抽取（KE）任务的重要性日益凸显。本文对文本与语音两种模态下关键词抽取的当代理论方法与实践解决方案进行了全面分析。本工作的主要贡献在于将这些往往彼此割裂的研究脉络系统地综合为一个统一的分析框架，突出了该领域从统计方法向大语言模型（LLMs）和端到端语音处理演进的发展历程。我们考察了关键词抽取的各个阶段、书面语与口语中关键词的特点，以及相关的术语细节。文中详细讨论并分析了多种自动关键词抽取方法：统计方法、混合方法、基于机器学习的方法以及结构化方法。本综述对新兴范式给予了大量关注，包括利用大语言模型进行关键词生成等（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文系统综述了文本与语音模态下自动关键词抽取的现代理论方法与实践方案，将这些分散的研究方向统一到一个分析框架中，并揭示了该领域从统计方法向大语言模型和端到端语音处理演进的趋势。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically surveys modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for automatic keyphrase extraction across text and speech, unifying disparate research strands into a single analytical framework and tracing the field's evolution from statistical methods to large language models and end-to-end speech processing.
